items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: There was Shelley Lamelle, Joseph Pierce, trumpet player, Nellie Lutcher was on the piano... Well that band did pretty good.

ctx.x: Well he's a pretty nice trumpet player. He was playing trumpet with us, Shelly LaMell. And we were quite a hit around Lake Charles. So the fellow said, well, Barnes, he said, Paul, he said, let us use your name. He called it the syncopated. He said, let us, you wouldn't mind if we use Paul Barnes? He said, you just come from New York with a big band from King Oliver, and that would be good when people hear it's Paul Barnes Band. I said, well, okay, if you want to use that name, you can go ahead and use it. So…
